refined_prompt: A northern Vietnamese young woman wearing a flat-brimmed quai thao hat. A northern Vietnamese young woman is wearing a flat-brimmed quai thao hat, a traditional Vietnamese accessory often seen with elegant garments. This hat, distinguished by its intricate silver ornaments hanging from delicate silk strings around the brim, is originally worn by shamans and royal court ladies in the early 20th century. Today, the quai thao hat serves as a symbol of elegance and cultural heritage in modern Vietnamese society, with the silver ornaments symbolizing wealth and cultural identity. Unlike other traditional Vietnamese hats such as the conical nón lá used for farm work, the quai thao hat is prominently worn in specific cultural and religious ceremonies.
